reason: Owner rule 2026-09-29: no output-token cap in any request Briglia builds (a reasoning model can spend a 10-token cap before answering and fail the setup probe). The Chat Completions setup probe (Probes.chatCompletion, WizardIO) drops "max_tokens": 10; under deterministic hashing its remaining keys keep their order, so the body loses exactly this byte sequence.
source_change: WizardIO.chatCompletion no longer sends max_tokens (wip/or-extractor-room); the Responses probes drop max_output_tokens 2048, the web pipeline and maintenance summaries drop their caps, none of which occur in any frozen capture
